import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    ratings = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    ratings.sort()
    
    # Split ratings into two teams
    team1 = ratings[:n]
    team2 = ratings[n:]
    
    # Check if every player in team2 is strictly better than every player in team1
    for i in range(n):
        if team1[i] >= team2[i]:
            print("NO")
            return
    
    print("YES")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
